name: eBay Lister
tagline: Photo to eBay draft: sold comps, title, price, your approval
description: Photograph a collectible such as comics, trading cards, toys or a thrift-store find and it builds a complete eBay draft: a researched title, a written description, and pricing grounded in what comparable items have actually sold for. Nothing goes live until you have confirmed the listing yourself.
author: Gabi_Valerio3
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
